title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.00 (unsettled) at 04:00 UTC on 10 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 10 日 04:00 UTC，估算行星 Kp 為 3.00（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.00 (3Z) at 04:00 UTC on 10 October 2026. The 04 hour is complete (60 samples through 04:59; hour-start 3.00/3Z, hour-end 2.67/3M). Last-180 maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-10T03:43:00; label 3Z). Published-window maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-10T03:43:00; label 3Z). Window starts 2026-10-10T00:01:00 (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 3.00. The 05 UTC hour on 10 October is incomplete (59 samples through 05:58; hour-start 2.67/3M, hour-end 2.33/2P).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 is the maximum estimated_kp in the most recent 180 samples. Published-window maximum is the max in the current feed window.
